title: Smooth section stabilization data
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings with B a smooth A-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], J an ideal of A, and σ:B→A/J an A-algebra map. There exist an étale A-algebra A₁ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a compatible A₁-algebra D smooth over A₁, and A-algebra maps j:B→D and τ:D→A/J with τ∘j=σ, such that A₁→D→A/J is surjective and (A/J)⊗_D Ω[D/A₁] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. No basis or lifts of basis elements are chosen.

source.place: Tag 07M7, first paragraph through the symmetric-algebra stabilization

proof.text: The reduced differential module P is finite projective by smoothness and base change. Choose a finite projective complement Kbar so P ⊕ Kbar is finite free.
Lift Kbar to a finite projective module K over an etale A-algebra A₁ inducing the quotient equivalence alpha. Set B₁=A₁ tensor_A B, with the transported section.

Set D=B₁ tensor_A₁ Sym(K). Smoothness follows from smoothness of Sym(K), base change and composition. Compose augmentation, the transported section and alpha inverse to obtain tau; the canonical B→D gives j and tau j=sigma.

By the universal properties of derivations and symmetric algebras, Omega of Sym(K) is Sym(K) tensor K. The tensor-product differential formula and reduction along the augmentation identify the reduced differentials of D with P ⊕ Kbar, hence free. The composite A₁→D→A/J is the quotient followed by alpha inverse, hence surjective.

proof_origin.description: Intermediate statement isolating the construction data needed by the differential-basis proof.

mathlib_searches.query: A smooth algebra with a section has a finite free cotangent module after adding a symmetric algebra of a projective complement
A smooth section to a quotient ring has finite free differentials after etale base change and symmetric algebra stabilization

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_section_differential_data
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.Smooth A B] (J : Ideal A) (σ : B →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J) :
    ∃ A₁ : CommAlgCat.{u} A,
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A A₁))) ∧
      ∃ (D : CommAlgCat.{u} A) (_ : Algebra A₁ D) (_ : IsScalarTower A A₁ D),
        Algebra.Smooth A₁ D ∧
        ∃ (j : B →ₐ[A] D) (τ : D →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J),
          τ.comp j = σ ∧
          Function.Surjective (τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A₁ D)) ∧
          letI : Algebra D (A ⧸ J) := τ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
          Module.Free (A ⧸ J) ((A ⧸ J) ⊗[D] KaehlerDifferential A₁ D)
